name: Aegisclack
description: Both rods hang loose as the user shifts weight, ready to spin a screen of rotation at the first threat.

name: Tempered Cordjoint
description: A rod whirled once about the wrist lands on the opponent's temple line with all its circling speed.

name: Glancing Backspin
description: Stepping around the edge of the spinning rod's circle, the user keeps its blur between self and foe.

name: Murkrod
description: One spoke of the whirling rod catches an overhead cut and drives it down to the ground.

name: Cleaving Capstick
description: The whirling rods advance like a turning door and press the opponent steadily backward across the ground.

name: Mayhemclack
description: A spinning rod slaps the flat of an incoming blade and knocks its point out of line.

name: Granite Hardstick
description: Both rods whirl at full pitch about the body, shielding every side against arrows, spears and swords alike.

name: Splitting Silt Chainjoint
description: The rods leave the whirl together and sweep a wide ring that strikes everyone standing close.

name: Hardened Roundstick
description: Qi spreads outward as a field in which the hanging rods turn in slow, ready orbits.

name: Gust Cascade
description: The rod rides a wide orbit steered by qi in the field and cuts in from the flank.

name: Silt Gripstick
description: Pivoting about the hinge's center line, the user moves beyond the reach of a pursuing blade.

name: Adamant Swingstick
description: A wide orbit meets an arrow volley or spear thrust and sweeps it out of the body's line.

name: Shade Sidespin
description: Two rods circle in opposite orbits, hemming the opponent's weapon into a narrowing space.

name: Shoulderroll Fastness
description: The crossing point of two orbits catches the opponent's wrist and strips the weapon from the hand.

name: Rodtorment
description: Letting the cord run to full length, the rod lashes in from outside the opponent's sight line.

name: Stifling Tiedend
description: A looping orbit settles its cord around the opponent's weapon arm and the user holds it fast with steady pull.

name: Facet Backspin
description: At the orbit's peak the rod drops as a single point of force that drives through a raised guard.

name: Charter Stickend
description: The cord is held with deliberate slack so the rods guard the body while the loop stays hidden.

name: Tempered Fliparound
description: A flick of the wrist throws the rod at the opponent's lead hand, trailing the loop behind it.

name: Might Octastick
description: The user glides forward on slack-footed steps, trailing the cord low so it never snags.

name: Stavecuirass
description: The loop drops over a wrist and a half turn of the rod hitches it tight.

name: Torrent Gripstick
description: The raised loop checks an arm thrust at the chest and slides it harmlessly past.

name: Thornclack
description: A low loop sweeps behind both ankles of the opponent and draws them together, stopping any step.

name: Octastick Fastness
description: A snare closes on the opponent's sleeve and the user uses the tension to pull himself into close range.

name: Toxin Cascade
description: The cord winds about a polearm shaft and a heave of both rods hauls the weapon off its line.

name: Thorn Hardstick
description: The cord is laid across the ground at ankle height beneath scattered dust, catching the first foot to cross it.

name: Thorn Neckwrap
description: Three loops thrown in quick succession close upon both arms and the weapon, leaving the opponent tangled.

name: Aegiswhirr
description: Rods and cord form a closed, mobile guard from knee to brow with qi steadying the whole.

name: Might Cordjoint
description: From a still stance the free rod falls in a clean vertical line onto the opponent's guard arm.

name: Rumblerod
description: The rod hits a post or shield, rebounds across the user's body and cuts from the other side.

name: Surging Fliparound
description: Qi in the surrounding field lightens each footfall so the user glides sideways without a sound.

name: Staunch Capstick
description: Both rods brace together to take a heavy stroke on their cord, then twist it away.

name: Rodthrash
description: A flick at the hinge drives the near rod forward as a short, hard jab to the throat line.

name: Shadeclack
description: Both rods sweep overlapping orbits, driving the opponent backward and keeping their weapon busy.

name: Stavebarrage
description: A rod thrown over the shoulder in a long arc comes down on the opponent's collarbone.

name: Rodcloak
description: Cord and rod close together around the opponent's forearm and twist it into a helpless lock.

name: Quelling Roundstick
description: A sudden twist of the hinge against the blade's guard pries the weapon loose and spins it away.

name: Lambasting Swingstick
description: Both rods swing a full circle at shoulder height and strike every opponent within the cord's reach.

name: Splitting Tiedend
description: The rods lock into a single qi-filled bar and drive downward through the guard onto the shoulder.

name: Aegis Chainjoint
description: The user stands with one rod set to guard and the other to strike, each on its own track.

name: Dowelbarrage
description: The left rod blocks while the right descends in the same breath onto the opponent's arm.

name: Whipping Tiedend
description: Feet cross where the rods' two tracks meet, taking the user into the opponent's blind side.

name: Equipoise Cordjoint
description: The two rods strike in a paired parry that carries a descending blade beyond either shoulder.

name: Lambasting Sidespin
description: One track guards while the other strikes in strict alternation, wearing down the opponent's attention.

name: Staggering Stickend
description: The paired rods close like shears around a limb or shaft and hold it between them.

name: Rodcuirass
description: After parrying with the guard track, the user swaps roles and strikes with the former guard.

name: Ravaging Backspin
description: Both rods arrive from opposite sides at once, closing on the opponent like pincers through the guard.

name: Hourclack
description: The user trades guard and strike between rods in a four-part chain, ending with both rods hitting together.

name: Facetstave
description: Crouched like a perched hawk, the user holds both rods back and high, shoulders lowered.

name: Rodbarrage
description: The rod falls steeply from above the head onto the opponent's guard like a hawk's first stoop.

name: Equipoise Roundstick
description: Arms spread wide, both rods sweep outward and turn aside blows coming from either flank.

name: Gust Neckwrap
description: A long low glide across the ground keeps the user's head level, like a hawk skimming.

name: Paralyzing Gripstick
description: The rod tip hooks behind an opponent's wrist like a talon and draws it down.

name: Toxinwhirr
description: A snap of the cord checks an opponent's lunge just as the user begins the dive.

name: Splintering Chainjoint
description: Springing upward, the user flicks the rod beneath the opponent's chin before landing.

name: Iron Shoulderroll
description: Having struck once, the rod rises again along the cord and drops a second time on the same line.

name: Murkclack
description: A drop aimed at the head makes the opponent look up while the other rod sweeps their legs.

name: Glintwhirr
description: Leaping, the user drops the first rod on the guard and the second follows through the opening in one descent.

name: Drubbing Neckwrap
description: Both rods wheel overhead like a circling hawk, then come down together on all who stand beneath.

name: Unflinching Swingstick
description: The user sits low in a stance that gives each rod its own court, one on either side.

name: Might Cascade
description: The rod nearest the intruder cuts down on whoever steps into its court.

name: Gust Sidespin
description: Sliding shuffles keep the user on the boundary between the two courts, forcing the opponent to commit.

name: Gust Octastick
description: The outer rod meets the incoming stroke early and shunts it beyond the user's court.

name: Compressing Fliparound
description: An opponent who enters the inner court has his weapon arm pinned between rod and cord.

name: Torrent Hardstick
description: The courts swap sides in a step, turning a blow away and answering from the freshly opened side.

name: Grinding Octastick
description: One rod holds the left court while the other presses the right, closing both sides on the opponent.

name: Stickend Cloak
description: The hinge turns the user's body between courts so fast that the opponent's committed attack lands on nothing.

name: Granite Chainjoint
description: Turned into the wind, the user lets the loose rods stream behind the forearms.

name: Gripstick Assault
description: A swing launched downwind gains speed from the gale and cuts across the opponent's guard.

name: Torrent Shoulderroll
description: The user steps with a gust at the back and covers twice the usual ground.

name: Unshaken Capstick
description: The rod meets the blow from the side and the crosswind carries it past the user.

name: Mayhemstave
description: A whistling snap of the cord beside the ear startles an opponent into a wasted guard.

name: Chime Swingstick
description: The rod rounds the sheltered side of the body, deflecting a stroke and flicking back at its owner.

name: Harpooning Backspin
description: Orbits turned against the wind raise a steady pressure that holds the opponent in place.

name: Thornrod
description: The wind-lifted cord curls round an opponent's weapon hand and is drawn back to the user.

name: Daybreak Neckwrap
description: Riding the wind, both rods sweep a vast circle that strikes all within the gale's reach.

name: Iron Roundstick
description: Holding one bearing through the orbit, the user drops the rod straight down through a guard.

name: Iron Hardstick
description: Feet set as on an open plateau, the user fixes a bearing and holds the rods against it.

name: Sanguine Stickend
description: The rod falls along the fixed bearing without wavering and lands exactly where the user has aimed.

name: Silt Capstick
description: The user walks the narrow line along a ledge or ridge top, rods held low for balance.

name: Gustclack
description: Bracing the rod against a buffeting wind, the user takes a blow without losing the bearing.

name: Gust Cordjoint
description: Without leaving the bearing the user shifts the rod to turn a blow and hit back along it.

name: Thorn Tiedend
description: The cord is cast beneath an opponent's foot on a rocky slope and snags the ankle.

name: Intent Cascade
description: Both rods advance along one fixed line, shoving the opponent steadily back toward the plateau's edge.

name: Chainjoint Onslaught
description: The rod falls from overhead exactly along the bearing and drives through even a raised double guard.

name: Ponderous Swingstick
description: The cord is cast over the opponent and the free rod set like an anchor, holding them in place.

name: Thorn Cordjoint
description: The user stands facing the wind with the cord lifted slightly, ready to cast it outward.

name: Neckwrap Assault
description: The rod is cast on the full length of the cord and swings round into the opponent's side.

name: Gust Fliparound
description: Gliding along the edge of a gust, the user crosses open ground before the opponent can square up.

name: Murk Roundstick
description: Drawing the cast rod back at once, the user parries a stroke with its returning swing.

name: Hoarfrost Octastick
description: Rods are planted before the chest in the posture of an oath, steady against any shove.

name: Rumble Tiedend
description: A quick tap from the windward rod distracts the opponent's guard before the real strike.

name: Whirrthrash
description: After the cast the rod is brought round on a long orbit and lashes the opponent's back.

name: Thorn Shoulderroll
description: The cord, thrown into the wind, curls round both arms of the opponent and tangles them.

name: Mayhem Shoulderroll
description: Recalling the cast cord with a snap, the user wrenches the opponent's weapon from the hand.

name: Shade Gripstick
description: With the cord running with the gale's line, the user presses the opponent backward with steady swings.

name: Driving Capstick
description: The rod is cast out on the wind and arrives from outside the opponent's sight, driving through the guard.

name: Gyve Hardstick
description: The cord is thrown wide on the wind and drawn back as a closing ring around the opponent.
